reason: It is not that it sounds wrong, it is that nothing is on fire badly enough this month to justify handing a stranger an hour and then a few grand. I already pay for software I half-use and I built the site myself, so I would probably hear you set this up wrong and get defensive.
objection: Free hour still costs me a Monday morning, and fixed price $1,500 to $3,500 depending on what it takes is not actually a fixed price, that is a range with a change order waiting in it. I have been burned by one more thing before.
would_change_my_mind: Someone in my line of work, another trades or dental office owner within an hour of Roscoe, telling me he found a real number, like ten hours a week or $4k in quotes that went cold, and that Donovin stuck to the number he quoted. Referral beats a pitch.
